leads.lead: Persisted policy read under a narrowed environment
leads.reason: Policy calls policy.New(set, env), refusing widening on read.
Registry hold checks skip expired pending holds; a live hold still blocks.

leads.lead: Workspace I/O uncertainty becomes absence and permits create-only overwrite
closureCriteria: Unreadable and otherwise uncertain native reads do not report confirmed absence.
Create-only PUT does not replace an existing unreadable object; original bytes survive refusal and permission repair.
True absence, healthy existing-object preconditions and symlink confinement remain correct.
Promote the native reproduction to regression coverage and qualify normal/race/conformance on Railway.

leads.reason: Existing managed capacity writer retains ErrUnknown reservations on uncertain errors; native permission regressions pass. This does not certify physical crash behavior.

leads.lead: SigV4 omits later values of a signed header
closureCriteria: A valid repeated-header request signed by the pinned AWS Go signer authenticates.
Adding or changing a later signed-header value without resigning is refused.
Preserve name-case handling, per-value whitespace normalization and existing authentication/operation-header refusal tests.

leads.lead: SigV4 sorts query names before URI encoding
closureCriteria: Canonical query order matches the encoded-key reference.
Pinned Node signer requests authenticate for ASCII and encoded-name fixtures.
Existing SDK, malformed-query and repeated ordinary-query cases remain qualified; no new request feature or signature fallback is added.

leads.lead: Lowercase unsigned-payload marker accepted with valid credentials
leads.reason: Confirmed noncanonical input acceptance, requiring a valid HMAC. The same credential holder can already select canonical UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD. No additional authority or body-integrity bypass is demonstrated. Stricter spelling is not counted as a required core correctness fix.

leads.lead: S3 write/COPY preconditions fold opaque ETag case
closureCriteria: Case-changed opaque tags compare unequal in the qualified PUT/COPY matrix.
Exact tags, wildcard and weak-validator contracts remain correct.
Cover the shared storage matcher and corresponding HTTP validator path without changing ETag generation or storage formats.

qualificationGaps: Browser persistence and exhaustive security review
